**Access boundary:** Authenticated browser session.

Current source uses the single V2 layout across five independently owned applications with zero import/design exceptions. The 9 November lifecycle candidate adds outcomes, full-dataset attention, navigation and bounded presentation presets, shared continuation/identity/navigation/poll/cache foundations, active-locale loading and three module splits. Exact-source tests, rendered accessibility, transfer and first-content evidence belong in LIFECYCLE_EXPERIENCE_EXECUTION.md and FRONTEND_PERFORMANCE.md; implementation alone establishes no hosted publication or physical-device qualification. The 10 November clarity candidate adds functional page titles, per-page browser titles, unknown-address recovery, a 12 px text floor with a four-step text scale, compact short tables, whole-row links, dispatch progress, file drop zones and on-demand first-page thumbnails; these presentation changes require exact-source test and publication evidence. The remaining B1 dirty-navigation source now uses localized exact-intent dialogs; B2 implements one explicit fixed UTC policy across the five browser apps without changing financial history or advertising an account timezone setter. Ordinary public Studio exposes a separately isolated read-only design fixture. These are implemented source contracts, not a claim of successful final CI, hosted publication or physical-device qualification.

**Surfaces:** Shared authenticated browser frame and application-owned lazy modules. Attention uses a new browser-only metadata read; outcomes, navigation commands and saved presentation presets grant no business authority. Native local drafts and backend contact/schedule/callback surfaces are documented separately.
